description: Request a service at a time. Check availability first. A fixed-price service costs the business's price from list_services; a different totalPrice you send is only noted for the business. A priced booking binds your person only once they confirmed it: without terms_sha nothing is sent, and you get the summary to show them (confirm.summary, confirm.terms_sha); call again with that terms_sha on their clear yes. Returns the item and, if you have no account, an access_token.

attachments.description: Photos or plans of the job: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, at most six of 10 MB each. Inline up to 4 MB each (8 MB a call), else by https address or upload_id. HEIC photos: send them as JPEG. Images are cleaned of where they were taken; a PDF is kept as sent.

upload_id.description: What POST /v1/uploads answered, within its hour.

data_base64.description: The file's bytes in base64: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 4 MB (8 MB in one call).

name.description: The file's name, for the business to recognise it.

url.description: An https address the file can be fetched from, up to 10 MB.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request = same answer. Required for agents.

key.description: The person's key (sdkey1_…), if that is all you have: it is exchanged once for a pass, which comes back in identity.passes — keep the pass and send it next time instead. Never stored.

pass.description: The person's passes (sdpass1_…), space-separated, at most 8: presented to the network that issued each, so the business recognises the customer. Or send them in the Sdi-Pass header. Never stored.

after.description: The fee after the last step, until the start.

value.description: Minor units of the currency's own ISO 4217 exponent (minorUnits): 4500 is CA$45.00 or ₹45.00, ¥4,500 in JPY, 4.500 in KWD.
Minor units of the currency's own ISO 4217 exponent (minorUnits): 4500 is CA$45.00 or ₹45.00, ¥4,500 in JPY, 4.500 in KWD.

steps.description: Cancelling before `until` costs `fee`; the steps are in order.

value.description: Minor units of the currency's own ISO 4217 exponent (minorUnits): 4500 is CA$45.00 or ₹45.00, ¥4,500 in JPY, 4.500 in KWD.

zone.description: The IANA zone the steps were dated in: the business's.

terms_sha.description: The fingerprint of the terms your person confirmed (details.terms_sha of the 409 confirm_terms a priced request without it gets). Nothing is sent to the business without it when the request carries a price.

visit_for.description: Book this as the site visit for a request for a price you made: its item_id (and access_token).

access_token.description: Capability secret returned when the item was created without an account.
